weights.csoNote: Capture bins cough at 'Chronic over 3 weeks', but WHO/Uganda screen TB at cough >=2 WEEKS (general population) and ANY duration in people with HIV — the 3-week bin UNDER-triggers TB and risks missing cases. Recommend a 2-week TB-screen trigger and any-duration-if-HIV rule. basePrior 4 reflects Uganda's very high TB burden in cough/haemoptysis presentations (setting-dependent at a referral hospital).
weights.weightCitation: WHO Consolidated Guidelines on TB, Module 2: Systematic Screening (2021) — prolonged cough >=2 weeks (general) / cough of ANY duration + four-symptom screen (W4SS) in people living with HIV; Uganda National TB & Leprosy Programme; WHO Operational Handbook on TB

weights.csoNote: basePrior lower than Western cough populations (TB dominates Uganda) but rising and often diagnosed late; consider scar carcinoma in old TB and non-smoking lung cancer in this population. Confirm local weighting.
weights.weightCitation: Davidson's Principles & Practice of Medicine 24th ed (2022); Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine 21st ed (2022)

weights.csoNote: Under-diagnosed in Uganda (limited CTPA/D-dimer) — basePrior reflects detection, not true incidence which is likely higher. Confirm with CSO.
weights.weightCitation: ESC 2019 Acute Pulmonary Embolism Guidelines (Konstantinides SV et al., Eur Heart J 2020;41:543-603)

weights.csoNote: Uganda: HIV-associated pneumonia common; consider TB and PCP in the differential of an HIV+ patient.
weights.weightCitation: Uganda Clinical Guidelines 2023 (pneumonia); WHO; Davidson's 24th ed; BTS CAP guideline

weights.csoNote: Uganda: rheumatic, hypertensive, peripartum and HIV cardiomyopathy are common causes (younger than Western HF); note pink frothy sputum/haemoptysis in pulmonary oedema and mitral stenosis.
weights.weightCitation: ESC 2021 Heart Failure Guidelines (McDonagh TA et al., Eur Heart J 2021;42:3599-3726); Davidson's 24th ed

weights.csoNote: There is no 'ACE-inhibitor use' capture token — 'hypertension' is used as an imperfect proxy for being on an ACE-I. Recommend adding an 'ACE-inhibitor use' (or current-medication) token so this common iatrogenic dry cough can be ranked properly.
weights.weightCitation: Davidson's 24th ed; CHEST Cough Guideline (chronic cough — upper-airway cough syndrome, GORD, ACE-inhibitor)

weights.csoNote: CONDITIONAL must-not-miss — pin only when HIV/immunosuppression present (advanced HIV, CD4<200). basePrior population-dependent. Hallmark: dry cough + exertional dyspnoea + hypoxia/desaturation on exertion disproportionate to CXR.
weights.weightCitation: WHO Guidelines on HIV-related opportunistic infections; Uganda Clinical Guidelines 2023 (HIV/PCP); Davidson's 24th ed (PCP — advanced HIV, CD4<200)

weights.csoNote: Uganda: POST-TB bronchiectasis is a leading cause of chronic copious-purulent-sputum cough and recurrent haemoptysis.
Uganda: aspiration (alcohol/reduced consciousness), post-pneumonic, or HIV-associated; large-volume FOUL-smelling sputum is the clue.

weights.dx: Acute bronchitis / viral respiratory infection (incl. COVID-19)
weights.csoNote: Most acute cough is self-limiting viral (incl. COVID-19/influenza); red flags (haemoptysis, weight loss, chronicity) must redirect to TB/cancer workup.
weights.weightCitation: Uganda Clinical Guidelines 2023; WHO (COVID-19 clinical management); Davidson's 24th ed (acute bronchitis / viral LRTI)

weights.csoNote: basePrior uncertain/under-recognised in Uganda, but chronic pulmonary aspergillosis/aspergilloma in OLD TB CAVITIES is increasingly described in sub-Saharan post-TB cohorts and is an important cause of recurrent and sometimes MASSIVE (life-threatening) haemoptysis. Confirm weighting/scope with CSO.
weights.weightCitation: Denning DW et al. on chronic pulmonary aspergillosis incl. post-TB disease in sub-Saharan Africa; WHO recognition of CPA; Davidson's 24th ed

weights.csoNote: Specialist diagnosis (bronchoscopic); basePrior uncertain. Consider in ADVANCED HIV with mucocutaneous/oral KS and haemoptysis — KS is among the commonest HIV-associated tumours in sub-Saharan Africa. Confirm scope (may sit in a specialist layer) with CSO.
weights.weightCitation: Davidson's 24th ed; sub-Saharan Kaposi sarcoma literature (Uganda Cancer Institute cohorts)
